customActions.name: uploadDocuments
customActions.description: Application page → + Add → Upload files. Sends the files in uploadFiles as multipart `files` to POST /apps/:appId/collections/:collectionId/documents/ (appId from the URL, collectionId from uploadCollectionId) with the signed-in token, reports uploaded / duplicate / failed counts, closes addToAppModal and refreshes the appFiles tree.

customActions.name: createCollection
customActions.description: Application page → + Add → New collection. POSTs { name, description } from newCollectionName / newCollectionDescription to /apps/:appId/collections/ (appId from the URL), then closes addToAppModal and refreshes the appFiles tree and the currentApp load (the upload collection list).

customActions.name: saveRag
customActions.description: Application page → RAGs tab → New / Edit modal → Save. With no ragId: POST { name, description } to /apps/:appId/rags/. With a ragId: PATCH { name, description, status } to /apps/:appId/rags/:ragId. Then PUT { documentIds } (the Files multi-select) to /apps/:appId/rags/:ragId/documents, and reloads the currentApp load the RAG table and pickers read. Throws the API message on failure so the modal stays open.

customActions.name: previewChunks
customActions.description: Application page → RAGs tab → RAG modal → Preview chunks. POSTs { chunkProfile: { chunkStrategyId, sizeUnitId, chunkSize, chunkOverlap }, documents: [{ documentId }] } (the modal's chunk settings and Files picker) to /apps/:appId/rags/chunk-preview?offset=0&limit=50, and puts the chunks into the currentApp load as chunkPreview (+ chunkPreviewSummary) for the modal's preview list.

customActions.name: clearChunkPreview
customActions.description: Application page → RAG modal → Cancel. Removes chunkPreview / chunkPreviewSummary from the currentApp load so the next modal starts empty.

projects.name: Glass showcase
projects.description: The Glass surface on every component: cards, tables with pinned columns, forms, a repeater, drawer / modal / popover — over the Book shop API.

config.text: One theme token — surface: "glass" — and every panel in the app becomes a translucent, blurred surface over the backdrop. Light and dark alike; flip the theme in the top bar.
The panel colour at 65% with a 16px blur and a hairline border. This card, the sidebar and the app bar are drawn with it.
Near-opaque and never blurred: a pinned cell hides what scrolls under it, and blur on many sticky cells is slow. See the Tables page.
Lighter than the panel it sits on — 40% with an 8px blur — so a field keeps its edge inside a glass card. The form below is on it.
A form on a glass container

config.name: overviewNote
config.html: Where the blur cannot run — the OS asks for reduced transparency, the browser has no backdrop-filter, or the page is printed — every tier falls back to the Strong look and the backdrop stays. Buttons keep their solid accent throughout.

config.text: The frame is one glass panel; the pinned Title column and the sticky header are the Strong tier, so nothing shows through them when you scroll sideways. Filter opens a glass popover with dropdowns; Add book / Edit open a glass modal full of fields.
